name: Mnemalloy-R3
description: A nickel-titanium-vanadium shape-memory alloy manufactured by Crucible Industries using nano-grain alignment processes that allow up to 47 discrete 'remembered' configurations to be encoded at the quantum lattice level. When exposed to a specific thermal or electrical trigger, the alloy returns with near-perfect fidelity to its programmed form, tolerating millions of cycles without fatigue degradation. Used everywhere from surgical actuators to deployable architecture.
story_hooks: A salvager finds coils of Mnemalloy-R3 with an unknown encoded configuration — heating it reveals the shape of something that shouldn't exist.
A prosthetic limb begins reverting to an old programmed shape at random, suggesting someone has remotely triggered an override signal.
Mnemalloy-R3 components in a collapsed building are being triggered by fire — the structure is slowly, terrifyingly reassembling itself around survivors.
